title: The human oversight point is not provable from GitHub's records: 0 of 52 window merges carry the owner's own approval
claim: In round 11's window, 31 of 52 merges carry an approval at head under the owner's account and all 31 are agent-declared; 0 carry one `budget_raise_gate.approval` reads as the owner's own, 49 of 52 were merged by the owner's account, and the agent/human split is made by review-body text alone (deleting the AGENT_DECLARED words turns all 31 into the owner's own with no GitHub-recorded field changed).
mechanism: Mandate 6893738184 (scope all, decision 0013) lets the orchestrator approve and merge as tvofi. GitHub's record (login, id, type) is identical for the agent and the owner, so the code-owner review that main-protect-checks requires, the only human-in-the-loop point GitHub enforces, is satisfied by an agent; whether a human acted is recoverable only from what the agent wrote, which is the 'comment's word' D11's NIST AI 600-1 bar excludes.

evidence.unit: window merges with an owner-own approval at head (of 52; 31 owner-account approvals all agent-declared)
evidence.contention_note: other finder seats on the box; counts over fixed snapshots, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb: delete every AGENT_DECLARED match from the owner-account review bodies (an undeclared agent)

metric_definition: window merges with an APPROVED review at merged head under login tvofi that budget_raise_gate.approval (no mandate reader) reads as the owner's own
phenomenon_property: Every merge's required human approval is attributable to a human from GitHub-recorded identity, not from body text an agent writes.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D11/s2/oversight.py (per window; the seams are every reader that keys on AGENT_DECLARED: grep -rn AGENT_DECLARED tools/)

null_control.note: the classifier is not blind: with the declaration text gone it reads all 31 as the owner's own, which is the text-keyed dependence the finding states

proposed_fix_scope: For the owner to rule: a separate GitHub identity for agent approvals under mandate (an App or a machine user listed as code owner only while a mandate is in force) so records alone separate agent from owner; or record per merge an owner act GitHub signs (the owner's own review) at a sampled rate.
